sentences.en: I was on Facebook the other day when a friend request came in.

sentences.en: It said my friendship choices on Facebook might be shaped by biases

sentences.en: Michelle Hebel is a psychologist at Rice University who ran the Facebook study.

sentences.en: She designed fictitious profiles for two men and two women.

两名女性的名字都叫詹妮弗·戴维斯。

sentences.en: The only real difference between the profiles were the photos.

sentences.en: One Photoshopped version of Michael Davis and Jennifer Davis had lighter skin.

sentences.en: to more than 1,000 people in a big American city.

sentences.zh: 由于这些都是虚构人物，大多数请求都被拒绝了。
